title: Fast and Useful: Adapting Distilled Generators for Visual Learning
title_zh: 快速且有用：将蒸馏生成器适配于视觉学习

paragraphs.en: Distilled text-to-image models generate images quickly, but classifiers trained on those images can perform substantially worse than classifiers trained on images from their slower base models. We adapt released distilled generators to produce better training data while retaining fast generation. We fit a low-rank update to the student’s first prediction so that it reaches an intermediate state produced by its unguided base, then disable the update and let the unchanged student finish generation. The base supplies training targets and is absent at inference. Guided targets and shorter jumps give classifiers lower accuracy in our ablations, showing why the state used for supervision matters. Across three generator families, the adapted images train better classifiers than images from the released students. With class-name templates at full ImageNet-1k scale, ResNet-50 top-1 rises from 8.4% to 34.2% for FLUX.2-klein and from 12.7% to 32.1% for SD-Turbo, using two and three denoiser evaluations per image, respectively. Fixed adapters also improve results on additional classes, fine-grained datasets, and other learner architectures and training recipes. Template-based adaptation remains useful against richer-prompt alternatives, while the benefit of combining adaptation with LLM generation prompts depends on the generator. Adapting a single generation step makes fast generators substantially more useful for training visual models.
paragraphs.zh: 蒸馏后的文生图模型生成图像速度很快，但在这些图像上训练的分类器性能可能远逊于在其较慢的基础模型所生成图像上训练的分类器。 我们对已发布的蒸馏生成器进行适配，以生成更好的训练数据，同时保留快速生成能力。 我们为学生模型首次预测拟合一个低秩更新，使其达到其无引导基础模型产生的某个中间状态，然后禁用该更新，让未改变的学生模型完成生成。 基础模型提供训练目标，且在推理时不存在。 在我们的消融实验中，引导目标与更短的跳跃会使分类器准确率更低，这说明用于监督的状态为何重要。 在三个生成器家族上，适配后的图像比已发布学生模型生成的图像能训练出更好的分类器。 在完整的 ImageNet-1k 规模上使用类名模板，FLUX.2-klein 的 ResNet-50 top-1 准确率从 8.4% 提升至 34.2%，SD-Turbo 从 12.7% 提升至 32.1%，每张图像分别使用两次和三次去噪器评估。 固定适配器还能改善在额外类别、细粒度数据集以及其他学习器架构和训练方案上的结果。 基于模板的适配相较于更丰富的提示词方案仍然有用，而将适配与 LLM 生成提示词相结合的收益则取决于生成器。 适配单个生成步骤可使快速生成器在训练视觉模型方面更加实用。

paragraphs.en: Synthetic images can expand training sets for computer vision without requiring another round of image collection and annotation. Text prompts provide control over the requested classes and allow datasets to be generated at different scales, supporting both learning from synthetic images alone and supplementing limited real data [ 32 , 2 , 16 ] . Their usefulness depends on what visual models learn from them: a generated dataset must help a classifier recognize real images.
paragraphs.zh: 合成图像可以扩展计算机视觉的训练集，而无需再进行一轮图像采集与标注。 文本提示可以对所请求的类别进行控制，并允许以不同规模生成数据集，既支持仅从合成图像学习，也支持补充有限的真实数据 [ 32 , 2 , 16 ] 。 它们的用处取决于视觉模型能从中学到什么：生成的数据集必须能帮助分类器识别真实图像。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-based text-to-image models make this approach flexible, but generating every image through many denoising steps becomes costly at dataset scale. Distillation compresses generation into a few predictions, making large synthetic datasets faster to produce [ 33 , 40 ] . That acceleration can come with a loss in the usefulness of the generated images. Adamkiewicz et al . [ 1 ] show that classifiers trained on images from released distilled generators can perform worse than classifiers trained on images from their full-step counterparts. We aim to retain the speed advantage while making the released student’s images more useful for learning.
paragraphs.zh: 基于扩散的文本到图像模型使这种方法变得灵活，但在数据集规模上通过多步去噪生成每张图像的代价很高。 蒸馏将生成过程压缩为少数几次预测，使大规模合成数据集的生成速度更快 [ 33 , 40 ] 。 这种加速可能伴随着生成图像有用性的下降。Adamkiewicz 等人 [ 1 ] 表明，使用已发布蒸馏生成器生成的图像训练的分类器，其性能可能差于使用完整多步对应模型生成的图像训练的分类器。 我们的目标是在保留速度优势的同时，使发布的学生模型的图像对学习更有用。

paragraphs.en: We study this problem by comparing changes to the generator while holding the classifier training procedure fixed. Lower guidance and richer prompts already improve synthetic-data learning [ 32 , 10 ] , and replacing a distilled model’s first steps with its base can restore sample diversity [ 14 ] . We measure how these choices affect classification on real images and use the resulting comparisons to construct supervision for a fast student. Additional classifier architectures and training recipes test whether the improvement extends beyond the primary learner.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过在保持分类器训练流程固定的情况下比较对生成器的改动来研究这一问题。 更低的引导强度和更丰富的提示词已能改进合成数据学习 [ 32 , 10 ] ，而用基础模型替换蒸馏模型的初始步数可以恢复样本多样性 [ 14 ] 。 我们衡量这些选择如何影响在真实图像上的分类，并利用由此得到的比较来为快速的学生模型构建监督信号。 额外的分类器架构和训练方案用于检验该改进是否超越了主要学习器。

paragraphs.en: Our approach trains a low-rank update to the released student’s first prediction. From initial noise, this prediction learns to reach an intermediate state produced by the unguided base. We then disable the update and let the unchanged student finish generation. The base supplies targets during preparation and is absent at inference; the adapted samplers use two denoiser evaluations for FLUX.2-klein and three for SD-Turbo. First-step teacher regression and post-hoc diversity adaptation have precedents [ 39 , 25 , 12 ] . We apply this supervision to released students while retaining their unchanged completion steps. Matched ablations establish how target guidance, jump endpoint, and update placement affect downstream classifier accuracy; comparisons with released models, base-first sampling, and available diversity methods test the resulting adaptation procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法对已发布学生模型的第一步预测训练一个低秩更新。 该预测从初始噪声出发，学习到达由无引导基模型产生的中间状态。 随后我们禁用该更新，让未改变的学生模型完成生成。 基模型在准备阶段提供目标，在推理时不存在；适配后的采样器对 FLUX.2-klein 使用两次去噪器评估，对 SD-Turbo 使用三次。 第一步教师回归和事后多样性适配均有先例 [ 39 , 25 , 12 ] 。 我们将该监督应用于已发布的学生模型，同时保留其未改变的完成步骤。 匹配的消融实验确定了目标引导、跳跃端点和更新位置如何影响下游分类器准确率；与已发布模型、基模型优先采样以及现有多样性方法的比较则检验了由此得到的适配流程。

paragraphs.en: Text-to-image models can supply images for training classifiers from scratch and supplementing limited real data [ 32 , 2 , 16 ] . The resulting accuracy depends on the generator, dataset size, prompts, and learning procedure. Lower guidance and richer descriptions improve supervised learning from synthetic images [ 32 , 10 ] , while StableRep uses multiple images generated from the same caption as positives for self-supervised representation learning [ 36 ] . These approaches establish useful ways to generate and learn from synthetic data. Adamkiewicz et al . [ 1 ] identify a complementary problem: images from newer and distilled generators can train weaker classifiers than images from older models. We address this problem by adapting released distilled generators and comparing their images under matched classifier training procedures, with additional learners testing the scope of the improvement.
paragraphs.zh: 文生图模型可以为从头训练分类器提供图像，并补充有限的真实数据 [ 32 , 2 , 16 ] 。 所得到的准确率取决于生成器、数据集规模、提示词和学习过程。 较低的引导强度和更丰富的描述能提升从合成图像进行的监督学习 [ 32 , 10 ] ，而 StableRep 将由同一描述生成的多张图像作为正样本，用于自监督表示学习 [ 36 ] 。 这些方法确立了生成合成数据并从中学习的有效途径。Adamkiewicz 等人 [ 1 ] 发现了一个互补的问题：来自更新、蒸馏后的生成器的图像，其训练出的分类器可能弱于来自旧模型的图像所训练的分类器。 我们通过改造已发布的蒸馏生成器，并在匹配的分类器训练流程下比较其图像来解决这个问题，同时通过额外的学习器检验该改进的适用范围。

sents.en: [ 1 ] identify a complementary problem: images from newer and distilled generators can train weaker classifiers than images from older models.
sents.zh: [ 1 ] 发现了一个互补的问题：来自更新、蒸馏后的生成器的图像，其训练出的分类器可能弱于来自旧模型的图像所训练的分类器。

sents.en: We address this problem by adapting released distilled generators and comparing their images under matched classifier training procedures, with additional learners testing the scope of the improvement.
sents.zh: 我们通过改造已发布的蒸馏生成器，并在匹配的分类器训练流程下比较其图像来解决这个问题，同时通过额外的学习器检验该改进的适用范围。

paragraphs.en: Latent diffusion and rectified-flow models support text-conditioned generation through iterative sampling [ 30 , 9 ] . Distillation reduces the number of model evaluations through objectives such as adversarial training, distribution matching, and consistency learning [ 33 , 41 , 40 , 26 ] . Although these methods enable fast generation, maintaining visual quality does not guarantee that the images remain equally useful for training classifiers [ 1 ] . We build on their released students, adapting a single prediction and retaining the student’s unchanged completion steps. This lets us test improvements to synthetic training data without training another distilled generator from its base.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在扩散与矫正流模型通过迭代采样支持文本条件生成 [30, 9]。 蒸馏通过对抗训练、分布匹配和一致性学习等目标减少模型评估次数 [33, 41, 40, 26]。 尽管这些方法能够实现快速生成，但保持视觉质量并不能保证图像对训练分类器仍然同样有用 [1]。 我们基于他们发布的学生模型，采用单次预测并保留该学生模型不变的补全步骤。 这使我们能够在不从基础模型训练另一个蒸馏生成器的情况下，测试对合成训练数据的改进。

paragraphs.en: Guidance schedules and condition annealing adjust the trade-off between fidelity and diversity [ 21 , 31 ] . Gandikota and Bau [ 14 ] restore diversity by using base-model predictions for the initial steps of a distilled sampler. We evaluate this base-first procedure as an alternative that requires no adapter training but uses the base at inference. Training-based methods also distinguish early structural variation from later refinement. DP-DMD supervises the first student step with a teacher-derived target and trains the remaining steps through distribution matching [ 39 ] ; CrossDistill assigns trajectory-preserving and distribution-matching objectives to different noise intervals in video generation [ 25 ] . CrossDistill’s direct-flow variant also regresses the first prediction toward an intermediate teacher state; our adaptation applies this supervision to a released image student while leaving its completion steps unchanged. Other methods likewise modify distillation objectives to preserve diversity [ 23 , 22 , 19 , 11 ] . SDA directly adapts released few-step models with teacher-guided directional alignment, and its Krea-2 release activates the adapter only during early sampling steps [ 12 , 13 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 引导调度与条件退火调节保真度与多样性之间的权衡 [ 21 , 31 ] 。 Gandikota 和 Bau [ 14 ] 通过在蒸馏采样器的初始步骤中使用基模型的预测来恢复多样性。 我们将这种基模型优先的流程作为一种替代方案进行评估，它不需要训练适配器，但在推理时使用基模型。 基于训练的方法同样区分早期的结构性变化与后期的精细化。 DP-DMD 用教师导出的目标监督学生的第一步，并通过分布匹配训练其余步骤 [ 39 ] ；CrossDistill 在视频生成中将轨迹保持与分布匹配目标分配到不同的噪声区间 [ 25 ] 。 CrossDistill 的直接流变体还将首次预测向教师的一个中间状态回归；我们的适配将这种监督应用于一个已发布的图像学生模型，同时保持其完成步骤不变。 其他方法同样通过修改蒸馏目标来保持多样性 [ 23 , 22 , 19 , 11 ] 。 SDA 通过教师引导的方向对齐直接适配已发布的少步模型，其 Krea-2 发布版本仅在早期采样步骤中激活适配器 [ 12 , 13 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Building on these early-step and post-hoc approaches, we fit the released student’s first prediction directly to an unguided intermediate teacher state and leave its completion steps unchanged. Matched ablations test how target guidance, endpoint, and update placement affect the accuracy of classifiers trained on the resulting images. Comparing with the public SDA adapter and further adapting DP-DMD’s released student establish where this correction improves downstream learning alongside existing diversity methods ( Tab. S8 ).

paragraphs.en: We adapt a released distilled generator so that classifiers trained on its images perform better on real images. The adaptation uses the corresponding full-step base as a teacher and preserves the released student for the remaining generation steps. We train a low-rank update to the first prediction to approximate an intermediate teacher state, then disable the update and let the student finish. The teacher is needed to prepare training targets but is absent at inference ( Fig. 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们对已发布的蒸馏生成器进行适配，使在其图像上训练的分类器在真实图像上表现更好。 该适配使用对应的全步基础模型作为教师，并在其余生成步骤中保留已发布的学生模型。 我们训练一个低秩更新来作用于首次预测，以逼近教师的中间状态，然后禁用该更新，让学生模型完成剩余步骤。 教师模型仅用于准备训练目标，在推理时并不存在（图 2）。

paragraphs.en: We compare generated datasets through the accuracy of classifiers trained on them, holding prompts, image seeds, and classifier training fixed within each comparison. Reducing base-model guidance improves this accuracy in the tested configurations, motivating targets that retain the base’s text-conditioned prediction without classifier-free guidance amplification. We call this setting unguided , corresponding to a standard guidance weight of one. The target still depends on the text prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过比较在各自生成数据集上训练的分类器的准确率来对比数据集，且在每次对比中保持提示词、图像种子和分类器训练固定不变。 在测试配置中，降低基础模型的引导可以提升该准确率，这促使我们采用保留基础模型文本条件预测但不含无分类器引导放大的目标。 我们将这一设置称为无引导，对应于标准的引导权重为 1。 该目标仍然依赖于文本提示词。

paragraphs.en: For each prompt and initial noise sample, we run the unguided base on a fine sampling grid and save its latent state at a selected noise level. This gives paired supervision: the released student receives the same noise and prompt and learns to predict a jump to that state. We compare guided and unguided teacher targets in the experiments to test this choice directly ( Tab. 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个提示词和初始噪声样本，我们在精细采样网格上运行无引导的基础模型，并保存其在选定噪声水平下的潜在状态。 这提供了成对监督：发布的学生模型接收相同的噪声和提示词，并学习预测跳转到该状态。 我们在实验中比较了有引导和无引导的教师目标，以直接检验这一选择（表 3）。

Our guidance-window comparisons show that strong guidance during early steps accounts for much of its observed cost to classifier accuracy. These results motivate learning the teacher’s early computation in one jump and reusing the student afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 目标还必须指定自适应预测应替换教师轨迹的多少部分。 我们的引导窗口比较表明，早期步骤中的强引导是其对分类器准确率造成所观测代价的主要原因。 用无引导的基础模型替换早期的学生预测，也比替换后期预测更能提升准确率（第 4.4 节）。 这些结果促使我们一次性学习教师的早期计算，并在之后复用学生模型。

paragraphs.en: Our primary comparison trains a ResNet-50 [ 15 ] from scratch on 500 generated images per ImageNet-100 class (CMC subset [ 37 ] ) and evaluates top-1 accuracy on the corresponding real validation images. paragraphs.en: Preparing teacher targets and fitting the first klein and SD-Turbo adapters costs 5.7 and 0.9 H100-hours, respectively. At 50,000 generated images, preparation makes adaptation more expensive overall than base-first, while the adapter gives higher accuracy and requires no base at inference. With template prompts at the measured throughputs, adaptation becomes cheaper overall than base-first after approximately 399,000 images for klein and 807,000 for SD-Turbo ( Tab. S2 ). We exclude SDA runtime from the speed comparison because our unmerged implementation does not represent an optimized deployment.

paragraphs.en: Changing guidance only during early or late generation steps shows that the early part accounts for much of the observed accuracy loss. Likewise, replacing early student steps with the unguided base improves accuracy more than replacing later steps. Detailed guidance-window and base/student comparisons support the early-step design ( Fig. S1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 仅在生成早期或后期步骤改变引导的实验表明，观察到的准确率损失大部分来自早期部分。 同样，用无引导的基础模型替换智能体的早期步骤比替换后期步骤更能提升准确率。 详细的引导窗口及基础模型与智能体的对比分析支持了早期步骤的设计（图 S1）。

sents.en: Changing guidance only during early or late generation steps shows that the early part accounts for much of the observed accuracy loss.
sents.zh: 仅在生成早期或后期步骤改变引导的实验表明，观察到的准确率损失大部分来自早期部分。

paragraphs.en: The adapter ablations then compare the teacher targets directly ( Tab. 3 ). With the same finer teacher grid on klein, an unguided target gives 43.2%, while a guidance-four target gives 20.1%. SD-Turbo and Z-Image show the same direction of change ( Sec. B.2 ). Stopping the adapted jump at the original first endpoint also underperforms the selected target on klein and SD-Turbo, as do the tested deeper endpoints. Keeping the adapter active during every step lowers accuracy, while increasing rank or training every weight gives comparatively small changes. Together, these comparisons support an unguided intermediate target and an update used only for the initial prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器的消融实验随后直接比较教师目标（表 3）。 在 klein 上使用相同的更精细教师网格时，无引导目标给出 43.2%，而四步引导目标给出 20.1%。 SD-Turbo 和 Z-Image 显示出相同方向的变化（见 B.2 节）。 在 klein 和 SD-Turbo 上，将适配后的跳跃停在原始第一终点也低于所选目标的表现，测试过的更深层终点同样如此。 在每一步都保持适配器活跃会降低准确率，而增加秩或训练所有权重则带来相对较小的变化。 综合来看，这些比较支持使用无引导的中间目标以及仅用于初始预测的更新。

sents.zh: 适配器的消融实验随后直接比较教师目标（表 3）。

sents.en: With the same finer teacher grid on klein, an unguided target gives 43.2%, while a guidance-four target gives 20.1%.
sents.zh: 在 klein 上使用相同的更精细教师网格时，无引导目标给出 43.2%，而四步引导目标给出 20.1%。

paragraphs.en: The ImageNet-trained adapters improve classifiers on Food-101, Cars, and Pets without retraining or changing their sampling settings ( Tab. 4 ). Our Z-Image-Turbo adapter exceeds SDA on all three datasets, and our adapter also improves DP-DMD’s released student on each dataset. The class-bootstrap intervals for all these gains lie above zero ( Tab. S10 ). SD-Turbo’s adapter exceeds base-first throughout; klein’s trails base-first on Cars. COCO captions can also replace class-name adaptation prompts ( Tabs. S6 and S11 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在 ImageNet 上训练的适配器（adapters）无需重新训练或更改采样设置即可提升分类器在 Food-101、Cars 和 Pets 上的表现（表 4）。 我们的 Z-Image-Turbo 适配器在全部三个数据集上均超过 SDA，且我们的适配器也提升了 DP-DMD 发布的学生模型在每个数据集上的表现。 所有这些增益的类自助法（class-bootstrap）置信区间均位于零之上（表 S10）。 SD-Turbo 的适配器全程优于 base-first；klein 的则在 Cars 数据集上落后于 base-first。 COCO 字幕也可以替代类别名称自适应提示词（表 S6 和 S11）。

sents.en: The ImageNet-trained adapters improve classifiers on Food-101, Cars, and Pets without retraining or changing their sampling settings ( Tab. 4 ).
sents.zh: 在 ImageNet 上训练的适配器（adapters）无需重新训练或更改采样设置即可提升分类器在 Food-101、Cars 和 Pets 上的表现（表 4）。

sents.en: Our Z-Image-Turbo adapter exceeds SDA on all three datasets, and our adapter also improves DP-DMD’s released student on each dataset.
sents.zh: 我们的 Z-Image-Turbo 适配器在全部三个数据集上均超过 SDA，且我们的适配器也提升了 DP-DMD 发布的学生模型在每个数据集上的表现。

sents.zh: 所有这些增益的类自助法（class-bootstrap）置信区间均位于零之上（表 S10）。

sents.en: SD-Turbo’s adapter exceeds base-first throughout; klein’s trails base-first on Cars.
sents.zh: SD-Turbo 的适配器全程优于 base-first；klein 的则在 Cars 数据集上落后于 base-first。

sents.en: COCO captions can also replace class-name adaptation prompts ( Tabs. S6 and S11 ).
sents.zh: COCO 字幕也可以替代类别名称自适应提示词（表 S6 和 S11）。

paragraphs.en: The gains persist with RandAugment, the reimplemented classifier recipe of [ 1 ] , ConvNeXt-T, and ViT-S/16 ( Tab. 5 ). Each comparison trains released-image and adapted-image classifiers under the same procedure. Their different gain sizes show that the learning recipe affects the magnitude, while the positive results support improvements beyond the primary ResNet-50 setup. Features learned from adapted images also transfer better to additional recognition tasks, and full-scale gains persist on shifted ImageNet test sets ( Tabs. S12 and S18 ).
paragraphs.zh: 使用 RandAugment、[1] 中重新实现的分类器训练方案、ConvNeXt-T 和 ViT-S/16 时，增益依然存在（表 5）。 每个对比实验都在相同的流程下训练发布图像分类器与适配图像分类器。 它们不同的增益幅度表明学习方案会影响增益大小，而这些正向结果支持在主要的 ResNet-50 设置之外仍有改进。 从适配图像中学到的特征也能更好地迁移到其他识别任务上，并且在偏移的 ImageNet 测试集上，全量规模的增益依然存在（表 S12 和 S18）。

sents.en: The gains persist with RandAugment, the reimplemented classifier recipe of [ 1 ] , ConvNeXt-T, and ViT-S/16 ( Tab. 5 ).
sents.zh: 使用 RandAugment、[1] 中重新实现的分类器训练方案、ConvNeXt-T 和 ViT-S/16 时，增益依然存在（表 5）。

sents.zh: 每个对比实验都在相同的流程下训练发布图像分类器与适配图像分类器。

sents.zh: 从适配图像中学到的特征也能更好地迁移到其他识别任务上，并且在偏移的 ImageNet 测试集上，全量规模的增益依然存在（表 S12 和 S18）。

paragraphs.en: Our template-based procedure remains useful against richer-prompt alternatives. At ImageNet-1k with 100 images per class, it exceeds released students using image-free LLM descriptions by +2.7 points for klein and +7.1 for SD-Turbo, and also exceeds base-first with LLM prompts ( Tabs. 6 and S17 ). These compare complete procedures with different generation prompts. Real-image captions also retain gains but require those images ( Tab. S14 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们基于模板的流程在面对更丰富的提示词替代方案时仍然有效。 在 ImageNet-1k 上每类 100 张图像的设置下，相比使用无图像 LLM 描述的已发布学生模型，它在 klein 上超出 +2.7 分，在 SD-Turbo 上超出 +7.1 分，并且也超过了使用 LLM 提示词的 base-first 方法（ 表 6 和 S17 ）。 这些对比了使用不同生成提示词的完整流程。 真实图像的描述同样能保持增益，但需要用到那些图像（ 表 S14 ）。

sents.en: Our template-based procedure remains useful against richer-prompt alternatives.
sents.zh: 我们基于模板的流程在面对更丰富的提示词替代方案时仍然有效。

sents.en: At ImageNet-1k with 100 images per class, it exceeds released students using image-free LLM descriptions by +2.7 points for klein and +7.1 for SD-Turbo, and also exceeds base-first with LLM prompts ( Tabs. 6 and S17 ).
sents.zh: 在 ImageNet-1k 上每类 100 张图像的设置下，相比使用无图像 LLM 描述的已发布学生模型，它在 klein 上超出 +2.7 分，在 SD-Turbo 上超出 +7.1 分，并且也超过了使用 LLM 提示词的 base-first 方法（ 表 6 和 S17 ）。

sents.zh: 这些对比了使用不同生成提示词的完整流程。

sents.en: Real-image captions also retain gains but require those images ( Tab. S14 ).
sents.zh: 真实图像的描述同样能保持增益，但需要用到那些图像（ 表 S14 ）。

paragraphs.en: Compared with the template-fitted adapters, the LLM-fitted variants give +3.3 points higher ImageNet-100 classifier accuracy for klein and 1.1 points lower for SD-Turbo. Both perform worse with template generation ( Tab. S16 ). At ImageNet-1k under matched LLM prompts, SD-Turbo’s template-trained adapter improves on released and base-first samplers, whereas klein’s selected LLM-fitted adapter falls below both. A post-hoc check finds the same for klein’s template-trained adapter. These directions hold on the 900 classes outside adapter fitting ( Tab. S17 ).
paragraphs.zh: 与模板拟合的适配器相比，大模型拟合的变体在 klein 上将 ImageNet-100 分类器准确率提高了 3.3 个百分点，在 SD-Turbo 上则降低了 1.1 个百分点。 两者在使用模板生成时表现均更差（表 S16）。 在 ImageNet-1k 上且使用相同的大模型提示词时，SD-Turbo 的模板训练适配器优于已发布采样器和 base-first 采样器，而 klein 所选的大模型拟合适配器则低于两者。 事后检验发现 klein 的模板训练适配器也呈现相同结果。 这些结论在适配器拟合之外的 900 个类别上依然成立（表 S17）。

sents.en: Compared with the template-fitted adapters, the LLM-fitted variants give +3.3 points higher ImageNet-100 classifier accuracy for klein and 1.1 points lower for SD-Turbo.
sents.zh: 与模板拟合的适配器相比，大模型拟合的变体在 klein 上将 ImageNet-100 分类器准确率提高了 3.3 个百分点，在 SD-Turbo 上则降低了 1.1 个百分点。

sents.en: Both perform worse with template generation ( Tab. S16 ).
sents.zh: 两者在使用模板生成时表现均更差（表 S16）。

sents.en: At ImageNet-1k under matched LLM prompts, SD-Turbo’s template-trained adapter improves on released and base-first samplers, whereas klein’s selected LLM-fitted adapter falls below both.
sents.zh: 在 ImageNet-1k 上且使用相同的大模型提示词时，SD-Turbo 的模板训练适配器优于已发布采样器和 base-first 采样器，而 klein 所选的大模型拟合适配器则低于两者。

sents.en: A post-hoc check finds the same for klein’s template-trained adapter.
sents.zh: 事后检验发现 klein 的模板训练适配器也呈现相同结果。

sents.zh: 这些结论在适配器拟合之外的 900 个类别上依然成立（表 S17）。

paragraphs.en: With limited real training data, adding adapted images improves real-only accuracy in the tested mixtures. With the full real ImageNet-1k training set, adding adapted images improves Sketch and R accuracy while slightly lowering in-distribution accuracy. The full results in the supplement delimit the settings in which synthetic augmentation helps ( Tabs. S18 and E.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在真实训练数据有限的情况下，在测试的混合比例中加入适配后的图像可以提升仅使用真实数据的准确率。 在使用完整的真实 ImageNet-1k 训练集时，加入适配后的图像可以提升 Sketch 和 R 的准确率，同时略微降低分布内的准确率。 补充材料中的完整结果界定了合成数据增强有效的设置范围（见表 S18 和 E.4）。

sents.en: With limited real training data, adding adapted images improves real-only accuracy in the tested mixtures.
sents.zh: 在真实训练数据有限的情况下，在测试的混合比例中加入适配后的图像可以提升仅使用真实数据的准确率。

sents.en: With the full real ImageNet-1k training set, adding adapted images improves Sketch and R accuracy while slightly lowering in-distribution accuracy.
sents.zh: 在使用完整的真实 ImageNet-1k 训练集时，加入适配后的图像可以提升 Sketch 和 R 的准确率，同时略微降低分布内的准确率。

sents.zh: 补充材料中的完整结果界定了合成数据增强有效的设置范围（见表 S18 和 E.4）。

paragraphs.en: Learning a jump to the selected unguided state gives higher classifier accuracy than matching a guided target or retaining the original first endpoint ( Tab. 3 ). The DP-DMD comparisons also show that substituting an unguided state alone can leave a substantial accuracy gap ( Sec. C.4 ). Together, these findings favor teacher targets that the unchanged student can complete.
paragraphs.zh: 学习跳转到所选的未引导状态比匹配引导目标或保留原始第一端点能获得更高的分类器准确率（表 3）。 DP-DMD 的比较还表明，仅替换为未引导状态可能会留下较大的准确率差距（C.4 节）。 综合来看，这些发现更倾向于选择未改变的智能体能够完成的教学目标。

sents.en: Learning a jump to the selected unguided state gives higher classifier accuracy than matching a guided target or retaining the original first endpoint ( Tab. 3 ).
sents.zh: 学习跳转到所选的未引导状态比匹配引导目标或保留原始第一端点能获得更高的分类器准确率（表 3）。

sents.en: The DP-DMD comparisons also show that substituting an unguided state alone can leave a substantial accuracy gap ( Sec. C.4 ).
sents.zh: DP-DMD 的比较还表明，仅替换为未引导状态可能会留下较大的准确率差距（C.4 节）。

sents.en: Together, these findings favor teacher targets that the unchanged student can complete.
sents.zh: 综合来看，这些发现更倾向于选择未改变的智能体能够完成的教学目标。

paragraphs.en: Template-based adaptation improves on released and base-first samplers on ImageNet-100 and on their LLM-prompt alternatives at ImageNet-1k with 100 images per class ( Figs. 3 and S17 ). For klein at this dataset size, we therefore recommend the original adapter with template generation; SD-Turbo benefits from adaptation with either prompt source. Released klein with LLM prompts avoids adapter preparation, and base-first improves its accuracy when the base can be loaded. Captions derived from real images retain gains for both models but require access to those images ( Tab. S14 ). Dataset also matters: base-first exceeds klein’s adapter on Cars ( Tab. 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 基于模板的适配在 ImageNet-100 上优于已发布采样器和 base-first 采样器，在 ImageNet-1k（每类 100 张图像）上也优于其使用 LLM 提示的替代方案（图 3 和图 S17）。 因此，在该数据集规模下，对于 klein 我们推荐使用配合模板生成的原始适配器；SD-Turbo 则无论使用哪种提示来源都能从适配中受益。 已发布的 klein 配合 LLM 提示可免去适配器准备，而在能够加载基础模型时，base-first 可提升其准确率。 由真实图像派生的描述文本能为两个模型保持增益，但需要访问这些图像（表 S14）。 数据集同样有影响：在 Cars 上 base-first 超过了 klein 的适配器（表 4）。

sents.en: Template-based adaptation improves on released and base-first samplers on ImageNet-100 and on their LLM-prompt alternatives at ImageNet-1k with 100 images per class ( Figs. 3 and S17 ).
sents.zh: 基于模板的适配在 ImageNet-100 上优于已发布采样器和 base-first 采样器，在 ImageNet-1k（每类 100 张图像）上也优于其使用 LLM 提示的替代方案（图 3 和图 S17）。

sents.en: For klein at this dataset size, we therefore recommend the original adapter with template generation; SD-Turbo benefits from adaptation with either prompt source.
sents.zh: 因此，在该数据集规模下，对于 klein 我们推荐使用配合模板生成的原始适配器；SD-Turbo 则无论使用哪种提示来源都能从适配中受益。

sents.en: Released klein with LLM prompts avoids adapter preparation, and base-first improves its accuracy when the base can be loaded.
sents.zh: 已发布的 klein 配合 LLM 提示可免去适配器准备，而在能够加载基础模型时，base-first 可提升其准确率。

sents.en: Captions derived from real images retain gains for both models but require access to those images ( Tab. S14 ).
sents.zh: 由真实图像派生的描述文本能为两个模型保持增益，但需要访问这些图像（表 S14）。

sents.en: Dataset also matters: base-first exceeds klein’s adapter on Cars ( Tab. 4 ).
sents.zh: 数据集同样有影响：在 Cars 上 base-first 超过了 klein 的适配器（表 4）。

paragraphs.en: Once fitted, the adapter improves classifier accuracy at comparable or lower generation time than the released student, without the base at inference ( Fig. 4 ). Preparation adds an initial cost: at 50,000 images, base-first is cheaper overall in the measured klein and SD-Turbo template settings, while adaptation gives higher accuracy ( Tab. S2 ). Adaptation is useful when this gain justifies preparation, the adapter can be reused, or inference requires only the student. The unguided base remains an option when its higher accuracy justifies slower sampling.
paragraphs.zh: 适配器拟合完成后，可在与已发布学生模型相当或更低的生成时间下提升分类器准确率，且推理时无需基础模型（图 4）。 准备工作会带来初始成本：在所测的 klein 和 SD-Turbo 模板设置中，当图像数量为 50,000 张时，先基础模型的方案总体上更便宜，而适配方案则给出更高的准确率（表 S2）。 当这一收益足以证明准备工作合理、适配器可被复用、或推理只需学生模型时，适配是有用的。 当基础模型较高的准确率足以抵消其较慢的采样速度时，无引导的基础模型仍是一个可选方案。

sents.en: Once fitted, the adapter improves classifier accuracy at comparable or lower generation time than the released student, without the base at inference ( Fig. 4 ).
sents.zh: 适配器拟合完成后，可在与已发布学生模型相当或更低的生成时间下提升分类器准确率，且推理时无需基础模型（图 4）。

sents.en: Preparation adds an initial cost: at 50,000 images, base-first is cheaper overall in the measured klein and SD-Turbo template settings, while adaptation gives higher accuracy ( Tab. S2 ).

sents.en: Adaptation is useful when this gain justifies preparation, the adapter can be reused, or inference requires only the student.
sents.zh: 当这一收益足以证明准备工作合理、适配器可被复用、或推理只需学生模型时，适配是有用的。

paragraphs.en: Our method requires a compatible base model to construct targets and an intermediate state that the released student can complete. We do not establish a rule that selects a useful endpoint for a new generator without this evaluation. Developing such a rule, or learning targets that better match the frozen student continuation, could reduce the cost of applying the method to additional generators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法需要一个兼容的基础模型来构造目标，以及一个已发布的智能体（学生模型）能够完成的中间状态。 我们根据下游分类器的结果，从学生模型的调度中凭经验选择终点。 我们没有建立一个能为新生成器选择有用终点的规则而不进行这种评估。 开发这样一种规则，或学习能更好地匹配冻结学生模型延续的目标，可以降低将该应用于更多生成器的成本。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation also has a development boundary. ImageNet-100, the 200-class protocol, and the small ImageNet-1k pilot informed method choices; they are not independent final tests. Full-scale ImageNet-1k and fine-grained evaluations use previously fixed adapters and samplers, but classes absent from adapter fitting can still have appeared during development ( Tab. S1 ). Most reported variation concerns classifier training, while adapter-training variation and independent dataset regeneration are measured for subsets of the comparisons. Repeating more comparisons with independently generated datasets would better characterize their uncertainty.
paragraphs.zh: 该评估也存在开发边界。 ImageNet-100、200 类协议以及小规模 ImageNet-1k 初步实验为方法选择提供了依据；它们并非独立的最终测试。 全规模 ImageNet-1k 与细粒度评估使用的是预先固定的适配器和采样器，但未出现在适配器拟合中的类别仍可能在开发阶段出现过（表 S1）。 大部分报告的差异涉及分类器训练，而适配器训练的差异和独立数据集重新生成仅在部分对比中进行了测量。 使用独立生成的数据集重复更多对比，将能更好地刻画其不确定性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate classification and feature transfer; detection and segmentation remain untested. Prompt-specific fitting is evaluated with one training run per adapter. The rich-prompt ImageNet-1k evaluation uses 100 images per class and one generated dataset per sampler, so it does not establish the outcome at the full synthetic dataset size. Understanding how prompt distributions interact with the adapted prediction and frozen completion steps could improve transfer across prompt regimes. Additional tasks require accuracy and preparation-cost evaluation. Adaptation also inherits the biases and coverage limitations of the released generators. Aggregate classification gains do not establish balanced performance across demographic groups or rare visual conditions, which require separate evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了分类与特征迁移；检测与分割尚未测试。 提示词特定的拟合通过每个适配器进行一次训练运行来评估。 丰富的提示词 ImageNet-1k 评估每类使用 100 张图像，且每个采样器只生成一个数据集，因此无法确立完整合成数据集规模下的结果。 理解提示词分布如何与适配预测及冻结补全步骤相互作用，可能有助于改进跨提示词机制的迁移。 附加任务需要准确率和准备成本的评估。 适配也继承了已发布生成器的偏差与覆盖范围局限。 总体的分类提升并不能确立在各人口群体或罕见视觉条件下的均衡性能，这需要单独评估。

paragraphs.en: We adapt released distilled generators to produce images that train more accurate visual classifiers. A low-rank update teaches the initial prediction to reach an unguided intermediate base-model state; the unchanged student then completes generation without the base at inference. Controlled comparisons establish the importance of target guidance, endpoint, and update placement. The improvements extend across three generator families, with fixed klein and SD-Turbo adapters also benefiting full-scale ImageNet training and fine-grained recognition. These results provide a simple way to improve training data from released generators while retaining fast generation. Prompt choice, preparation cost, and inference requirements determine the most useful configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们改造已发布的蒸馏生成器，使其生成能够训练更准确视觉分类器的图像。 一个低秩更新教导初始预测达到无引导的中间基座模型状态；在推理时，未改变的学生模型随后在没有基座的情况下完成生成。 受控对比实验确立了目标引导、端点和更新位置的重要性。 这些改进扩展到三个生成器系列，固定的 klein 和 SD-Turbo 适配器也在全规模 ImageNet 训练和细粒度识别中获益。 这些结果提供了一种简单的方法，可以在保留快速生成的同时改进来自已发布生成器的训练数据。 提示词选择、准备成本和推理要求决定了最有用的配置。

paragraphs.en: This section specifies dataset roles, classifier training, generator settings, adapter fitting, and cost accounting.

paragraphs.en: The default learner is a ResNet-50 [ 15 ] trained from scratch for 100 epochs. We use SGD with Nesterov momentum 0.9, learning rate 0.2 at batch size 256, five warmup epochs followed by cosine decay, weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , label smoothing 0.1, and bf16 autocast. Training uses random resized crops to 224 pixels and horizontal flips; evaluation resizes to 256 and center-crops to 224. The ViT-S/16 uses AdamW with learning rate 5 ⋅ 10 − 4 5\cdot 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.05, ten warmup epochs, and RandAugment (2, 9).
paragraphs.zh: 默认的学习器是一个从零开始训练 100 个 epoch 的 ResNet-50 [15]。 我们使用带动量为 0.9 的 Nesterov 的 SGD，学习率为 0.2，batch size 为 256，先进行五个 warmup epoch 然后余弦衰减，权重衰减为 10^{-4}，标签平滑为 0.1，并使用 bf16 自动混合精度。 训练使用随机裁剪缩放至 224 像素以及水平翻转；评估时先缩放至 256 再中心裁剪至 224。 ViT-S/16 使用 AdamW，学习率为 5\cdot 10^{-4}，权重衰减为 0.05，十个 warmup epoch，并使用 RandAugment (2, 9)。

paragraphs.en: The recipe of [ 1 ] , used in Tabs. 5 and S13 , uses Adam at 10 − 3 10^{-3} , batch size 1,024, 80 epochs, CutMix, gradient clipping, and the published augmentations. paragraphs.en: Unless stated otherwise, each generated set is evaluated with three classifier seeds, and tables report their mean and standard deviation. ImageNet-100 results for the three primary adapters and the first-level DP-DMD adapter pool three adapter-training seeds with three classifier seeds each. Transfer evaluations use the first trained adapter. Ablations use one adapter-training seed, except SD-Turbo rank 128, which uses three. Data-scaling evaluations use two classifier seeds, with the exception identified in the scaling caption. We assess generation variability by independently regenerating four headline sets. Top-1 averages test images. Gaps use mean per-class accuracy and paired class-bootstrap intervals after averaging classifier runs. Mean-class and image-averaged accuracy can differ on imbalanced test splits. The intervals condition on the observed datasets and fitted adapters; classifier and adapter runs do not count as independent dataset regenerations.
paragraphs.zh: 除另有说明外，每组生成的集合均使用三个分类器随机种子进行评估，表格报告其均值和标准差。 ImageNet-100 上三个主要适配器及第一级 DP-DMD 适配器池的结果，使用三个适配器训练随机种子，每个种子搭配三个分类器随机种子。 迁移评估使用第一个训练得到的适配器。 消融实验使用一个适配器训练随机种子，但 SD-Turbo 秩 128 例外，其使用三个种子。 数据规模缩放评估使用两个分类器随机种子，缩放说明中指出的例外情况除外。 我们通过独立重新生成四个核心集合来评估生成的变异性。 Top-1 对测试图像取平均。 差距基于各类别平均准确率计算，并在对分类器运行取平均后使用配对的类别自助法区间。 在不平衡的测试划分上，类别平均准确率与图像平均准确率可能有所不同。 这些区间以观测到的数据集和已拟合的适配器为条件；分类器和适配器的多次运行不计作独立的数据集重新生成。

paragraphs.en: ImageNet classifiers are evaluated on the real validation images of their classes, 50 per class. The default real-data reference draws 500 images per class from the training split. Fine-grained synthetic sets also contain 500 images per class, but evaluation uses each dataset’s test split. Their real-data references use 500 real images per class for Food-101, all 8,144 training images for Cars, and all 3,680 for Pets. These references train for the same number of optimization steps as the generated sets.

paragraphs.en: Adapter optimization uses a disjoint 5% of noise/target pairs (at least 64) to measure state-regression error, with a fixed split seed of zero. paragraphs.en: DINOv3 features use the ViT-L/16 pretrained on LVD-1689M: the 1,024-dimensional final normalized class token, after bilinear resizing of the short side to 256 and center-cropping to 224 with ImageNet channel normalization. CLIP uses OpenAI ViT-L/14 projected image embeddings (768 dimensions), bicubic resize/crop to 224 and CLIP channel normalization. We L2-normalize both feature types. Precision, recall, density, and coverage use Euclidean distances within each class, with the fifth-nearest-neighbor radius excluding self-distances ( k = 5 k=5 ); metrics average over 100 classes with 500 real training and 500 generated images each. Recall is the fraction of real features inside the union of generated-feature balls. Fréchet distances use whole-set means and unbiased covariances. FID uses 2,048-dimensional Inception-v3 pool3 features with TensorFlow-FID weights, bicubic resize/crop to 299, and the same 50,000 real training images as reference. Preference metrics use 5,000 evenly spaced images per set: the LAION improved-aesthetic head on normalized CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings and PickScore v1 scores for image and prompt pairs.
paragraphs.zh: DINOv3 特征使用在 LVD-1689M 上预训练的 ViT-L/16：即 1,024 维的最终归一化类别标记，先将短边双线性缩放至 256，再中心裁剪至 224，并进行 ImageNet 通道归一化。 CLIP 使用 OpenAI ViT-L/14 投影后的图像嵌入（768 维），双三次缩放/裁剪至 224，并进行 CLIP 通道归一化。 我们对两种特征均进行 L2 归一化。 精确率、召回率、密度和覆盖率使用每类内的欧氏距离，排除自身距离后取第五近邻半径（ k = 5 k=5 ）；指标在 100 个类别上取平均，每类包含 500 张真实训练图像和 500 张生成图像。 召回率是落在生成特征球并集内的真实特征比例。 Fréchet 距离使用全集均值和无偏协方差。 FID 使用 2,048 维的 Inception-v3 pool3 特征及 TensorFlow-FID 权重，双三次缩放/裁剪至 299，并以同样的 50,000 张真实训练图像作为参考。 偏好指标使用每集合中均匀间隔的 5,000 张图像：在归一化的 CLIP ViT-L/14 嵌入上使用 LAION 改进美学头，并对图像与提示对使用 PickScore v1 打分。

paragraphs.en: Timings use one H100. The klein and Z-Image students, adapters, and base-first hybrids use batches of eight; SD-Turbo uses 32, while its unguided SD 2.1 base uses 16. Klein/Z-Image run in bfloat16 and SD in float16; the low-rank update is evaluated in float32. Each recorded batch interval starts immediately before the text-to-image pipeline call and ends after CUDA synchronization. It includes prompt encoding, denoising, and VAE decoding, and excludes model loading, image encoding, and writing packs. We average per-image times over the generated images, including the first batch; no separate warm-up batches are discarded. Legacy default-model timings use the first 256 images at the recorded settings. These are measured pipeline throughputs at the stated batch sizes, not batch-one latency or separately optimized hardware limits. FSG timings include its feature optimization. MoNO generates images sequentially and includes noise optimization, generation, and feature-history updates, with prompt encoding amortized over its input batch. Exact batch sizes for the other generators are in the manifest.
paragraphs.zh: 计时测试使用单张 H100。 Klein 与 Z-Image 的学生模型、适配器和基础优先混合模型使用批大小 8；SD-Turbo 使用 32，而其无引导的 SD 2.1 基础模型使用 16。 Klein/Z-Image 以 bfloat16 运行，SD 以 float16 运行；低秩更新以 float32 计算。 每个记录的批区间从文生图管线调用之前立即开始，到 CUDA 同步之后结束。 其中包括提示词编码、去噪和 VAE 解码，不包括模型加载、图像编码和写入数据包。 我们对生成图像的每张图像时间取平均值，包括第一个批次；不单独丢弃预热批次。 旧版默认模型的计时使用记录设置下的前 256 张图像。 这些是在所述批大小下测得的管线吞吐量，而非单张图像延迟或经过单独优化的硬件极限。 FSG 的计时包括其特征优化。 MoNO 按顺序生成图像，并包括噪声优化、生成和特征历史更新，提示词编码摊销到其输入批次中。 其他生成器的确切批大小见清单文件。

paragraphs.en: The cost for M M generated images is C ⁡ ( M ) = C pairs + C fit + M ​ t image C(M)=C_{\rm pairs}+C_{\rm fit}+M\,t_{\rm image} , counting preparation once per released adapter. Klein’s 5.7 H100-hours of preparation amortize against its unguided 20-step base at approximately 44,000 images; SD-Turbo’s 0.9 hours amortize against unguided SD 2.1 at approximately 38,000 images. Against base-first, the corresponding crossovers are approximately 399,000 images for klein and 807,000 for SD-Turbo under template prompts. These estimates use recorded per-image times and job-level preparation costs, assuming constant throughput and counting preparation once. They exclude sampler development and downstream classifier evaluation. paragraphs.en: We evaluate the released zit_sda_v1.safetensors adapter [ 13 ] on Z-Image-Turbo at its documented eight steps. Applying it throughout reaches 25.1 ± \pm 0.1, versus 20.9 ± \pm 0.2 with activation limited to the first two steps and 13.8 ± \pm 0.4 without it (three classifier seeds each). paragraphs.en: We use existing recognition datasets, released generators, and COCO captions; we do not collect a new human-subject dataset. Generated data can inherit the source models’ biases and omit rare visual conditions. Higher aggregate accuracy or recall does not establish demographic fairness or safety in deployment; downstream uses require validation on their intended populations and conditions. The adapter reduces generation cost relative to full-step sampling, but target construction and classifier evaluation add computation. Preparation and per-image generation costs are reported separately.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用现有的识别数据集、已发布的生成器以及 COCO 标注；我们并未收集新的人类受试者数据集。 生成数据可能继承源模型的偏差，并遗漏罕见的视觉条件。 更高的总体准确率或召回率并不能证明部署中的群体公平性或安全性；下游用途需要在目标人群和条件下进行验证。 与完整步骤采样相比，该适配器降低了生成成本，但目标构建和分类器评估增加了计算量。 准备成本与单张图像的生成成本分别报告。

paragraphs.en: Guiding only the first 10 of 50 FLUX.2-klein steps costs 17.5 of the 21.4 points lost with full-trajectory guidance. paragraphs.en: Completing a fine-grid base state at the student’s first level reaches 32.8 on klein and 32.5 on SD-Turbo; stopping at its second level reaches 43.5 and 47.1. paragraphs.en: Published interval guidance [ 21 ] , transferred without retuning, reaches 45.9 on klein but only 40.7 on SD 2.1, versus 49.8 unguided. paragraphs.en: With the base’s default guidance applied at every target integration step, as in DP-DMD’s released teacher implementation, the adapter loses 23.1 points ([20.2, 26.2]) on klein and 13.2 ([10.5, 16.1]) on SD-Turbo. It retains only 11% and 48% of the unguided-target gain. Completing the guided teacher states with the distilled model gives 23.6 and 30.5; the guided-target adapters perform at or below those references. On 200 classes, their losses relative to the standard adapters are 25.4 and 8.7 points.
paragraphs.zh: 当如 DP-DMD 已发布的教师实现那样，在每个目标集成步骤都应用基础模型的默认引导时，适配器在 klein 上损失 23.1 分（[20.2, 26.2]），在 SD-Turbo 上损失 13.2 分（[10.5, 16.1]）。 它们仅保留了无引导目标增益的 11% 和 48%。 用蒸馏模型补全带引导的教师状态可得到 23.6 和 30.5；带引导目标的适配器的表现处于或低于这些参考值。 在 200 个类别上，它们相对于标准适配器的损失分别为 25.4 分和 8.7 分。

paragraphs.en: The same direction holds on Z-Image: the default-guidance target costs 18.8 ([16.4, 21.3]) points, 18.1 on 200 classes, and retains 11% of the gain. This is consistent with 1.x-Distill’s motivation for removing high-noise teacher guidance to preserve layouts [ 22 ] , but evaluates a different outcome. In all three families, the default-guidance targets also retain at most 32% of the Vendi gain and 25% of the recall gain (first training runs). Thus the guided targets lose diversity and training value together.
paragraphs.zh: 同样的方向也适用于 Z-Image：default-guidance 目标损失 18.8（[16.4, 21.3]）个点，在 200 类上为 18.1，并保留了 11% 的增益。 这与 1.x-Distill 移除高噪声教师引导以保留布局的动机一致 [22]，但评估的是不同的结果。 在全部三个模型家族中，default-guidance 目标最多也只保留了 32% 的 Vendi 增益和 25% 的召回率增益（首次训练运行）。 因此，带引导的目标同时失去了多样性和训练价值。

paragraphs.en: Ending at the student’s original first level reaches only 32.1 on klein and 32.2 on SD-Turbo, retaining 57% and 55% of the full gain. Those results resemble completion from the base’s own states at the same levels (32.8 and 32.5); a later distilled step still traverses the sensitive interval. Vendi gains are similarly limited (22% and 39%). Deeper is not always better: 40.0 and 41.2 for deeper klein and SD-Turbo jumps fall below the selected targets. These comparisons support the selected intermediate target over either the original first endpoint or the deepest tested endpoint; they do not define a universal structural threshold.

paragraphs.en: The adapter preserves target content for individual seeds ( Fig. 2 ). In DINOv3 space, an adapted image is more similar to the completed teacher state from its own initial noise than to states from other noise. The cosine-similarity advantage is 0.32 for klein, compared with 0.27 for base-first and 0.05 for the distilled model. Corresponding SD-Turbo values are 0.33, 0.27, and 0.08. This correspondence supports the interpretation that the adapter learns the target trajectory while the aggregate diversity comparisons alone do not identify how that correspondence arises.
paragraphs.zh: 该适配器为各个种子保留了目标内容（图 2）。 在 DINOv3 空间中，经适配的图像与其自身初始噪声生成的补全教师状态更为相似，而不是与其他噪声生成的状态相似。 klein 的余弦相似度优势为 0.32，而 base-first 为 0.27，蒸馏模型为 0.05。 对应的 SD-Turbo 数值分别为 0.33、0.27 和 0.08。 这种对应关系支持了如下解释：适配器学习到了目标轨迹，而仅凭聚合多样性比较无法确定这种对应关系是如何产生的。

paragraphs.en: DP-DMD [ 39 ] regresses its student’s first step onto the teacher’s state at guidance 3.5 and trains the later steps by distribution matching. Its released SD3.5-Medium student falls 7.2 points below the guided teacher ([5.5, 8.9]), while removing guidance raises the teacher by 23.8 points ( Tab. S7 ). Our adapter, fitted on top of the student toward the unguided teacher, adds +7.7 ([+6.2, +9.3]) at the student’s first level and +13.4 ([+11.1, +15.7]) at its second, and exceeds base-first at the first level by +5.9 ([+4.4, +7.4]; +6.7 on 200 classes). It recovers 25% and 43% of what the unguided teacher adds over the student. From the unguided teacher’s first-level state, the student reaches only 15.8. An unguided intermediate state alone is therefore insufficient: recovery depends on its compatibility with the remaining student trajectory. This comparison does not distinguish a mismatch at the hand-off from loss within the student’s later steps.
paragraphs.zh: DP-DMD [39] 将其学生的第一步回归到引导为 3.5 时的教师状态，并通过分布匹配训练后续步骤。 其发布的 SD3.5-Medium 学生模型比引导教师低 7.2 分（[5.5, 8.9]），而移除引导使教师提升 23.8 分（表 S7）。 我们的适配器在学生模型之上向无引导教师拟合，在学生的第一层级增加 +7.7（[+6.2, +9.3]），在其第二层级增加 +13.4（[+11.1, +15.7]），并在第一层级超过 base-first +5.9（[+4.4, +7.4]；在 200 个类别上为 +6.7）。 它分别恢复了无引导教师相对学生所提升幅度的 25% 和 43%。 从无引导教师的第一层级状态出发，学生仅达到 15.8。 因此，仅靠无引导的中间状态是不够的：恢复取决于它与学生剩余轨迹的兼容性。 这一比较无法区分交接处的失配与学生后续步骤中的损失。

paragraphs.en: At 500 real images per class, adding adapted images improves accuracy over both real-only training and augmentation with released-student images. paragraphs.en: Within family f f , we transform metric and accuracy ranks to ( rank f − ( n f + 1 ) / 2 ) / n f (\operatorname{rank}_{f}-(n_{f}+1)/2)/n_{f} and correlate the concatenated transformed ranks. Intervals use 10,000 bootstrap resamples of sets within each family (seed zero). For leave-one-family-out prediction, we fit isotonic regression on all other families. Its direction follows their Spearman sign; tied predictor values are averaged with multiplicity weights, predictions interpolate linearly between knots and clip at the endpoints. We repeat these fits in each bootstrap resample, then rank-correlate predictions and accuracies in each held-out family and across all out-of-fold predictions. This evaluates ranking, not calibrated accuracy prediction. SDXL and the small FLUX.1-dev family remain uncertain; recall is a set-level diagnostic rather than a reliable predictor within every unseen family.
paragraphs.zh: 在族 f f 内，我们将度量与准确率排名变换为 ( rank f − ( n f + 1 ) / 2 ) / n f (\operatorname{rank}_{f}-(n_{f}+1)/2)/n_{f}，并对拼接后的变换排名计算相关性。 区间使用每个族内集合的 10,000 次 bootstrap 重采样（随机种子为零）。 对于留一族的预测，我们在其余所有族上拟合保序回归。 其方向遵循它们的 Spearman 符号；取值相同的预测变量按重复次数加权取平均，预测在节点之间线性插值并在端点处截断。 我们在每次 bootstrap 重采样中重复这些拟合，然后在每个留出族内以及所有折外预测上对预测值与准确率进行秩相关计算。 这评估的是排名能力，而非经过校准的准确率预测。 SDXL 和小规模的 FLUX.1-dev 族仍不确定；召回率是一种集合层面的诊断指标，而不是在每个未见族内都可靠的预测变量。

paragraphs.en: To isolate weighting from configuration membership, we compare both summaries on the same four families meeting the original minimum of eight sets: klein, SD 2.1, SDXL, and Z-Image (178 sets).
